description: Defines data structures, enums, and functions for Bluetooth key management, including key types, key storage, retrieval, and handling of link keys.

methods.name: bt_irk_eq
methods.description: Compares two IRK structures for equality based on their 'val' fields.

methods.name: bt_keys_foreach_type
methods.description: Iterates over all keys of a specified type, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: bt_keys_store
methods.description: Stores a key to persistent memory if enabled.

methods.name: bt_keys_link_key
methods.description: Retrieves or manages Bluetooth link keys associated with device addresses.
